testpage.note: Calibration on the approved test page at the plan's rects. Interiors (10 px inset) of all three pairs are pixel-identical; the full rects differ only within 10 px of the edge, i.e. the hand-inked wobbly border is drawn per POSITION, not per panel ID. B2 requires the full crops identical (max abs diff 0): U3 must draw each border with a seed keyed by panel ID (or paste one border raster per ID) so the paired crops match edge to edge.
